title: The Hidden Trophy Ballad
intro: Minutes before the talent show, the school's beloved silver microphone has vanished from the auditorium stage.

suspects.name: Priya
suspects.line: Ask anyone, I was in the green room all morning.

suspects.name: Mira
suspects.line: I'm rehearsing my song, not hiding anything, thank you.

suspects.name: Theo
suspects.line: I came in late, only because my bike got a flat tire.

suspects.name: Owen
suspects.line: I only stepped out to refill my water bottle.

suspects.name: Lila
suspects.line: Microphones are way too heavy for me to carry around.

clues.text: A witness saw the culprit last of all, lingering in the hallway just outside the auditorium doors, right before the mic vanished.
The cocoa cart stayed spotless and untouched, so the culprit was not the one who grabbed a cup of cocoa before the show.
The sign-in sheet shows the culprit did not arrive early; they walked in only after the rest of the crowd had settled in.
A sticky cup on the snack table smells of lemonade, and the culprit was the only one seen sipping it near the stage.
